scientific_question: Does adding observed-R1 ViennaRNA MFE features improve fixed-GFP HEK293 intronless Flow-seq prediction under whole-sequence-cluster OOD evaluation, despite the previous random-variant development no-go?

prior_evidence.note: RK27 used measured Kudla 5-prime MFE on complete CDS. RK28 uses ViennaRNA-predicted MFE on the observed 300-nt R1 fragment; this is not direct external replication of the measured feature.

preregistration_card.observed_phenomenon: RK27 found a strong measured-MFE increment under fixed-GFP sequence-cluster OOD in E. coli, whereas RK02 found no observed-R1 structure increment in random-variant HEK293 development folds.
preregistration_card.falsifiable_hypothesis: For both ridge and HistGB, adding three observed-R1 MFE features improves held-out-cluster Spearman and reduces held-out-cluster MSE relative to the identical simple-feature model, with cluster-aware uncertainty excluding zero and positive effects in at least 8 of 10 frozen fold-assignment seeds.
preregistration_card.data_and_split: All 152 finalized Mordstein HEK293 intronless Flow-seq variants; frozen 90% complete-linkage clusters over the observed 300-nt R1 sequence only; five-fold whole-cluster OOF evaluation.
preregistration_card.controls: The strong comparator is the identical backbone trained on depth, observed-R1 GC3, GC, CpG and CAI without structure. MFE-only is descriptive. Training-fold mean is the null.
preregistration_card.primary_metrics: structure-minus-simple global OOF Spearman and simple-minus-structure global OOF MSE for ridge and HistGB; positive favors structure.
preregistration_card.expected_evidence: All four effects positive, cluster-bootstrap 95% CI above zero, Holm cluster-swap p<0.05 and at least 8/10 positive seed effects.
preregistration_card.falsification: Any failed primary endpoint rejects the family-wide HEK293 observed-R1 structure-transport claim.
preregistration_card.next_decision: A pass motivates genuinely independent full-CDS functional validation; a fail rejects robust cross-study structure transport. Neither outcome alone authorizes generator training or completes RK-G1.

cai_wrapper.caveat: The raw external reference behavior is retained for comparability with RK02, including its known whitespace/frame caveat; it is not a validated clean human reference set.

label_free_coverage_audit.linkage: SciPy complete linkage on condensed Hamming distance 1-identity over the 300 observed positions; no alignment, outcome or model feature is used.
label_free_coverage_audit.selection_rule: The 90% threshold is frozen now. No alternative threshold may be tried after seeing coverage or outcomes.
label_free_coverage_audit.feasibility_rule: Require 152 unique variant IDs and unique 300-nt ACGT sequences, at least 10 clusters, largest cluster <=121 rows (<=80% rounded down), and primary-seed fold sizes each >=5 with at least 2 clusters per fold. Otherwise close as COVERAGE_INFEASIBLE_ZERO_FITS without reading outcomes or fitting models.

outer_evaluation.type: five-fold grouped OOF evaluation on frozen observed-R1 sequence clusters
outer_evaluation.fold_assignment: For each seed, numpy.random.default_rng(seed) shuffles sorted unique cluster IDs; stable-sort shuffled IDs by descending cluster size. Assign each whole cluster to a currently least-loaded fold, breaking load ties with the same RNG. Cluster ID, not outcome, determines every assignment.
outer_evaluation.leakage_rule: No observed-R1 sequence cluster may occur in both train and test. Scaling and outcome standardization are fitted within training folds only. No feature selection or hyperparameter tuning.

outcome.name: flowseq_score_r1_only
outcome.interpretation: R1-assigned HEK293 intronless Flow-seq weighted fluorescence-bin score; not direct RFU, translation velocity, decay or universal expression.

models.structure_engine: ViennaRNA RNA.fold_compound MFE; DNA converted to RNA; 37 C; dangles=0; full observed 300-nt fragment and every contiguous 48-nt window. This is predicted fragment MFE, not measured structure or full-CDS initiation MFE.
models.ridge: Training-fold feature and outcome mean/population-standard-deviation scaling, then Ridge(alpha=1.0, solver=cholesky).
models.histgb: HistGradientBoostingRegressor(loss=squared_error, learning_rate=0.05, max_iter=200, max_leaf_nodes=7, min_samples_leaf=10, l2_regularization=1.0, early_stopping=False, random_state=fold_seed).

cluster_bootstrap.procedure: Resample frozen cluster IDs with replacement to the observed number of clusters, include every variant in each selected cluster, and recompute each paired OOF effect. Percentile two-sided 95% CI.

cluster_swap_permutation.procedure: Draw one sign per cluster and swap simple/structure predictions for every variant in that cluster. Two-sided absolute-effect p-value with plus-one correction.

primary_inference.multiplicity: Holm across exactly four primary tests.
primary_inference.seed_sensitivity_rule: At least 8 of 10 seed-level global OOF effects must be positive for every primary endpoint.

pass_rule: All four primary endpoints must have observed effect >0, cluster-bootstrap 95% CI entirely above zero, Holm-adjusted cluster-swap p<0.05 and at least 8/10 positive fold-assignment-seed effects.
